experiment: Ohm Wild 0.11.0 reuse-output with stock-compatible verification of visible test executables
ordinary_environment: Uninstrumented cargo +ohm with default GCC and no WILD_* setting. Release 14 Cargo and compiler, 8 Cargo jobs, CPUs 0-23, dedicated devbox and independently trained targets at identical absolute paths.
reuse_targets: Carry forward the finished v7 subject targets, switch to the registered binary, then settle, train both edited/restored states, and explicitly verify both states before scoring. Preserve every earlier receipt and measurement.
stats: Each endpoint has 18 three-subject blocks containing three of each of six permutations, independently shuffled using its listed seed. Condition on each other subject's position and enumerate all 8000 balanced exchanges for a two-sided exact randomization test. Holm correction across all six primary contrasts. Report stratified paired bootstrap 95% intervals and unadjusted arm medians.
gates: Match complete build/test rosters, restore exact source and Git index, allow zero registry compiles after settling, require a next all-fresh command after every sample. Trace the actual linker/rustc invocations and authenticated hits on first/last edits separately. A reported improvement must show fewer authentic full links on both traces and be significant against both controls. For a large test skip claim, require at least half of full links avoided in both traces, and independent full-link byte-for-byte verification of representative hits.
genuine_miss: Use the complete historical Pydantic edit, checksum 467330a56398032bfaed34cca5a89ed7de1a6459ddb95756180b16de69b912b1, one separate full-workspace build series of 12 paired balanced blocks against the source-matched parent, seed 1738074. Default-activation gate requires the upper end of the pointwise paired bootstrap 95% time-overhead interval below 2%. Keep negative and failed tests in evidence.
v7: Immutable predecessor and earlier exact-input experiments remain separate. No old samples enter the v8 analysis. Do not condition the test family or stopping on interim times.
